g.text: one row per planet x chart type)

ul.li: Slice 1 SHIPPED: Baaladi + Jagradadi — star-schema (tbl_Dim_PlanetaryState / tbl_Rule_AgeState / tbl_Rule_WakefulnessState / tbl_Fact_PlanetaryState), computed by PlanetaryStateComputer in ChartGenerationService, on vw_Chart_Consolidated. 270 fact rows.
Deeptadi / Lajjitadi / Sayanadi: not built (follow-on slices).
jyotishganit/components/states.py is an empty stub; the vendored PyJHora copy has no avastha module.
Source: BPHS (public-domain) + B.V. Raman, Graha and Bhava Balas (not in repo — cited-edition discipline).

g.text: tbl_BirthDetails time -> janma ghatis (NOT persisted per-chart)

div.p: 5 states from degree-in-sign: Baala 0-6 / Kumara 6-12 / Yuva 12-18 / Vriddha 18-24 / Mrita 24-30 (reversed in even signs). Effect fraction per state (.25/.50/1/.125/0). AgeStateCalculator.cs + tbl_Rule_AgeState (RuleSetId 1). D1 only. verify-avastha.

3 states from dignity: Jagrat (own / exalted / moolatrikona) / Swapna (friend / neutral) / Sushupti (enemy / debilitated). WakefulnessStateCalculator.cs + tbl_Rule_WakefulnessState (RuleSetId 1). Every chart type.

9 states, precedence-ordered: Deepta(exalted) / Swastha(own) / Mudita(friend) / Shanta(benefic sign) / Deena(enemy) / Vikala(combust) / Peedita(hemmed by malefics) / Khala(debilitated / with malefic) / Garvita(moolatrikona). Needs a natural benefic/malefic classifier over conj+aspect planets. Textual variants -> pin a source.

6 states: Lajjita (5th house + with Rahu/Ketu/Sun/Mars/Saturn) / Garvita (exalted / moolatrikona) / Kshudhita (enemy sign / with an enemy / with Saturn) / Trishita (watery sign, malefic aspect, no benefic aspect) / Mudita (friend sign / with a benefic / with Jupiter) / Kshobhita (with Sun + malefic + no benefic aspect). All ingredients stored; needs the same benefic/malefic + node classification layer.
The planet-to-planet associations the 6 Lajjitadi states key off (conjunct Jupiter -> Mudita, conjunct Saturn -> Kshudhita, conjunct Sun -> Kshobhita, ...).

ul.li: Missing: the classification (benefic / malefic / node / luminary) and the Lajjitadi mapping

div.p: 12 states (Sayana..Nidra) from a birth-time + nakshatra + lagna + planet-number formula, plus a Cheshta/Drishti sub-state (partly from speed — now stored: SpeedLongitudeDegPerDay). Needs: janma ghatis persisted, a planet-number map, and a cited edition (high textual variance).

Id, ChartResultId, BirthDetailId, ChartType, Planet, RuleSetId, AgeStateId + AgeEffectFraction (D1 only, FK tbl_Dim_PlanetaryState), WakefulnessStateId (every chart type, FK tbl_Dim_PlanetaryState), ComputedAt. Later slices ADD: DeeptadiStateId, SayanadiStateId, + child tbl_Fact_PlanetaryStateLajjita.
